POV: You spent 3 hours blending that foundation, perfecting that eyeshadow, and creating the most flawless base of your life… just to remove it like you're scrubbing a burnt pan. 😭😂 Learn the right technique people! Take the effort to remove your makeup and for heaven's sake do not sleep with your makeup on! People tend to blame all their skin issues on makeup products but do not see their own fault such as using makeup brushes that have not been washed since it was purchased or improper makeup removal. Once you remove the makeup, ensure to hydrate your skin well. I have used @try.subset hydrating face serum. It has a non greasy, light weight finishing with amazing hydrating and cellular repair ingredients!
